test_greedy_geodesic_follower: test the GreedyGeodesicFollower navigation agent across multiple navmeshes with parametrized move filters and action noise
run_pathfinder_navmesh_tests: run the PathFinder tests by loading navmesh files and computing shortest paths between random navigable points
test_noisy_actuation: test the agent with PyRobotNoisyActuationSpec for noisy move forward, turn left, and turn right actions
review_ACCEPTABLE_SPLS: review the ACCEPTABLE_SPLS dictionary that defines minimum success weighted path length thresholds per move filter and noise combination
